text:
Hannah Ortiz: Quick thread for candidate Miguel Alvarez visiting next Wed 2pm PT. Needs a short whiteboard interview + laptop loaner (Linux dev image) for a CLI-focused task. Also asked about bicycle parking and whether we reimburse local transit. Can folks confirm?

Evan Patel: I can do 2-3pm. Will be remote but can come in if needed.

people-ops: Noted. We can loan a Linux laptop (ASSET LOAN-2217) from 1:30-4:00. Will prepare a guest shell account mg.alvarez+staging@redwood.ai for the task. Transit reimbursement: up to $40 for local transit or we can prepay a rideshare if arrival is outside light rail times. Which does candidate prefer?

Hannah Ortiz: He prefers transit reimbursement. Please include instructions for reimbursing via Ramp and prefill the expense template. Also, Miguel mentioned he cycles to campus; can facilities confirm bike rack availability and secure storage?

facilities: We have covered bike rack B2 near Entrance A and a secure bike locker (first-come) in Bike Room 3. If he needs the locker, we can reserve for the day and provide a temporary key code. We'll add directions to the candidate packet.

Hannah Ortiz: Great, please reserve the locker for Wed if possible. Also he requested a quiet room for a short break between interviews (sensitive meds). Could we reserve a small private room?

people-ops: Reserved Private Room P4 from 1:45-3:30. We'll note on the packet where it is and include a contact at Reception. Also adding a printed NDA and a paper copy of the coding prompt in large text per his preference.

it-ops-bot: VPN creds generated for mg.alvarez+staging@redwood.ai. Temporary password sent via secure email. Asset LOAN-2217 imaged with Linux dev image and power adapter included.

travel-bot: Calendar event created: "Miguel Alvarez  Onsite Loop" Wed 14:00-15:15 PT. Bike locker and laptop loaner attached. Ramp expense template linked.

Evan Patel: Sounds good. One note  the CLI task needs curl and jq available; people-ops, can you confirm the loaner has those installed?

people-ops: Confirmed  curl and jq installed, plus Git and ssh keys disabled by default (we'll enable ssh for the session if needed).

Hannah Ortiz: Awesome. If the candidate arrives early, Reception will hold the laptop and give directions to Private Room P4. Thanks all  closing loop. :white_check_mark:
